# GMEOW Languages Module

The GMEOW Languages Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/languages>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/languages`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Languages and writing systems as first-class, registry-INDEPENDENT information objects (the BCP-47 / ISO 639 / Glottolog / Wikidata / schema.org superset layer). A gmeow:Language has a self-minted IRI; codes (gmeow:languageCode, gmeow:authorityLink, skos:exactMatch) are OPTIONAL alignments, never identity — so a code-less conlang (Ithkuil), a fast-versioning AI-minted interlingua, an under-coded sign/minority language, and a programming language are all co-equal first-class languages. Covers natural, constructed (auxiliary/engineered/artistic/ritual), AI-generated, historical/reconstructed, sign/whistled/tactile, and formal/programming/markup languages. Writing systems are first-class and a language CO-MINGLES many co-equal scripts (Japanese = kanji/Hani + hiragana/Hira + katakana/Kana + rōmaji/Latn), bound by the reified gmeow:WritingSystemUsage relator (mirroring names' gmeow:NameUsage), which also models script changes over time (Turkish Arabic→Latin, 1928). Versions form a first-class lineage (gmeow:versionOf / supersedes). Endonym/exonym names reuse the names module's gmeow:Appellation; transliteration schemes that produce a gmeow:romanization are named by gmeow:transliterationScheme and catalogued as FnO functions in the projection layer.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/languages>
